summary: PGIM Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing routine monthly items: declaration of regular August 2026 distributions of $0.16851 (Class S), $0.18050 (Class D) and $0.18550 (Class I) per share, payable September 28, 2026 to holders of record August 31, 2026, plus July 31, 2026 NAVs of $24.89, $24.80 and $24.32 per class. Aggregate NAV was $298.2 million, portfolio fair value $453.0 million and debt outstanding $159.6 million. The continuous offering of up to $2.5 billion in shares remains ongoing, with $281.1 million issued. No special-situation transaction is present.
